ai_language_tip: Speak polite Central Thai (th) and end sentences with the polite particle matching the caller's gender (khrap/kha); English works at hotels, international hospitals and tourist venues in Bangkok, Phuket and Chiang Mai.
english_ok: sometimes — Good at hotels, international hospitals and tourist areas; limited at local eateries, garages, markets and government offices.
politeness: Soft and polite: greet with sawasdee plus khrap/kha, use khun + first name, avoid raising the voice; thank with khop khun khrap/kha.
name_tip: Thais use the given name with khun ('คุณ' + first name), not the surname; many also use a short nickname; bookings usually go under first name or nickname + phone.
phone_tip: Mobile 10 digits (08-1234-5678, also 06x/09x); Bangkok landline 02-123-4567; LINE ID is often linked to the same mobile; read back in 3-3-4 groups.
time_tip: CRITICAL: everyday Thai uses a six-hour clock: 'สองทุ่ม' = 20:00, 'บ่ายสอง' = 14:00, 'ตีสอง' = 02:00; official/booking texts use 24-hour 'น.' (19.30 น.); always read back in 24-hour.
number_tip: Read digits singly in Thai or English; prices in baht; the Buddhist year (พ.ศ. = AD + 543) appears on documents and some dates.
avoid_calling: Avoid lunch rush 11:30–13:00 and dinner 18:00–20:00 at eateries, calls after 21:00, and the Songkran (13–15 April) and New Year periods when many family shops close.
closed_days: Office weekend is Sat–Sun; many family eateries close one weekday; Songkran and some Buddhist holidays close small shops; alcohol sales are banned on major Buddhist holidays and election days.
booking_channels: LINE (shop LINE Official Account) is the default for restaurants, salons, clinics and tradesmen; Wongnai/Chope/Hungry Hub for dining, Grab/LINE MAN for delivery, Grab/Bolt for rides, hospital apps for doctors.
voice_menu: Telcos (AIS, True-dtac), banks, hospitals' call centres and Thailand Post use IVR with Thai/English options; small shops answer directly or reply on LINE.
callback_habits: Shops usually confirm in the LINE chat or by SMS; platform bookings send SMS or e-mail with a booking number; hospitals send LINE or SMS reminders the day before.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 潛水、一日遊、泰拳課與高爾夫多可 LINE 或電話預約；國家公園與熱門景點多要線上購票或登記。

may_come_up.what: Some national parks require online pre-registration
Island tour price includes hotel pickup or not

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport numbers for boat or park permits

usually_asked: Which tour, class or tee time

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊、美甲、按摩多在 LINE 對話預約，熱門店要先轉帳訂金；觀光區泰式按摩店多接現場客，不一定接電話預約。

may_come_up.what: Nail or lash shops ask a transfer deposit before keeping the slot
Tourist-area massage shops say walk-ins are fine, no booking needed

sensitive_asked.what: Requests ID card photo before a beauty booking

usually_asked: Service and length: Thai massage 1 or 2 hours, gel nails, hair colour

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消多在原本的 LINE 對話處理；Wongnai 訂位可從確認信的連結自行取消，醫院預約可在 LINE 官方帳號改期。

may_come_up.what: Hospital LINE account lets the patient reschedule or cancel by themselves
Deposit for a package booking may not be refunded

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the booking number from the confirmation e-mail

usually_asked: Name and mobile on the original booking
Booking number from Wongnai or Hungry Hub if any

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公立醫院多用衛生部「หมอพร้อม」LINE 或 App 取號預約，須以 13 位身分證號註冊；私立醫院也用自家 LINE 官方帳號預約，回診要報病歷號（HN）。

may_come_up.what: Public hospitals point callers to the Mor Prom LINE account for an online queue number
Private hospital needs an HN (hospital number) for returning patients

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the 13-digit Thai ID number to register or verify the patient

usually_asked: New patient or has an HN already
Patient's full Thai name and date of birth
Mobile for LINE or SMS reminders

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信（AIS、True）、銀行與電力公司客服有泰語／英語語音選單，帳戶事項須本人以身分證號驗證。

may_come_up.what: Telco says account changes need the SIM owner

sensitive_asked.what: Asks Thai ID number or bank OTP

usually_asked: IVR option for Thai or English

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 政府手續多需本人到場或走各機關網站與 App；學校可電話詢問，週末與佛教節日不接。

may_come_up.what: District office (อำเภอ/เขต) handles ID and house registration in person

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the house registration (ทะเบียนบ้าน) details

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 冷氣清洗、水電與清潔多電話或 LINE 叫；住公寓（คอนโด）時常要先向管理處（นิติบุคคล）報備師傅進出。

may_come_up.what: Aircon cleaning priced per unit and BTU size
Condo juristic office may require advance notice for contractors

sensitive_asked.what: Asks payment before the technician arrives

usually_asked: Job type and number of aircon units (BTU)
Condo name, building, floor and room or soi/house number

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 連鎖飯店多經 Agoda、Booking.com 或官網，小旅館與民宿常用 LINE 或電話；依《旅館法》入住須登記身分證或護照。

may_come_up.what: Guest must show a passport or Thai ID at check-in for the hotel register
Long-weekend rooms need a transfer deposit

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to send a passport photo by LINE before arrival

usually_asked: Guest name as on passport or ID

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 詢問營業時間、潑水節是否營業、可否刷卡或掃 PromptPay、有無停車位；佛教節日與選舉日禁止賣酒，餐廳酒類供應會受影響。

may_come_up.what: Says no alcohol is sold on Buddhist holy days or election days
Explains Songkran opening days

usually_asked: Whether alcohol is served that day

pet.before_dialing_zh: 動物醫院與寵物美容多可電話或 LINE 預約，回診會問寵物病歷號；寵物旅館要看疫苗本。

may_come_up.what: Grooming price depends on breed and weight
Vet asks to bring the vaccine book

sensitive_asked.what: Pet hotel wants full prepayment to an individual's account

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多看 DDproperty、Livinginsider 與 Facebook 社團，房東與仲介習慣用 LINE 約看房；一般收押金加預付租金。

may_come_up.what: Agent asks to continue on LINE
Typical deposit is two months plus one month advance

sensitive_asked.what: Asks a viewing fee before showing the condo

usually_asked: Condo or house name and listing
Move-in date and lease length (often 1 year)

repair.before_dialing_zh: 汽車保養（เช็คระยะ）多照里程數到原廠預約；機車與冷氣維修多直接電話或 LINE 傳照片詢價。

may_come_up.what: Dealer service centre books the check by mileage interval (เช็คระยะ)
Garage gives a price only after seeing photos sent on LINE

sensitive_asked.what: Dealer asks the car registration book (เล่มทะเบียน) details

usually_asked: Car or motorbike model, year and Thai plate with province
What is wrong or which part

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 泰國餐廳多用 LINE 官方帳號或電話訂位；用 Wongnai 網頁訂位最多可提前 30 天，設有套餐的店要先付訂金；Hungry Hub 多為自助餐套餐，30 人以上要填團體表單。

may_come_up.what: Wongnai package bookings need a deposit paid on the booking page before confirmation
Bib Gourmand-type shophouses take bookings only by LINE or phone, often cash only
Hungry Hub buffet package price is per head and fixed per package

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to pay the PromptPay deposit from the caller's own account

usually_asked: Date and time, said in 24-hour (น.) or the six-hour clock
Name or nickname plus a Thai mobile for the SMS/LINE confirmation
Special occasion note such as a birthday

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕、花束與節慶禮籃常在 LINE 下單並先付 PromptPay 訂金；母親節、情人節前要提早。

may_come_up.what: Custom cake needs a deposit by PromptPay and a design picture on LINE

sensitive_asked.what: Requests full payment to an unrelated individual's account

usually_asked: Cake size in pounds (ปอนด์) or flower count

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 小吃店可電話或 LINE 點餐自取，外送主要走 Grab Food 與 LINE MAN；常問辣度、要不要加蛋或少甜。

may_come_up.what: Shop says delivery is only through LINE MAN or Grab Food
Pay by PromptPay QR when collecting

sensitive_asked.what: Asks to transfer to a personal PromptPay number before cooking a small order

usually_asked: Spice level (เผ็ดน้อย/เผ็ดมาก) and extras

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Thailand Post、Flash、J&T、Kerry（KEX）多用官網、App 或 LINE 官方帳號以追蹤號查件，客服電話多為語音選單。

may_come_up.what: Courier LINE account answers tracking by number

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the OTP sent to the receiver's phone

usually_asked: Tracking number from Thailand Post, Flash, J&T or KEX

transport.before_dialing_zh: 叫車以 Grab、Bolt 為主；機場接送與包車可 LINE 或電話預約；雙條車（songthaew）多路邊叫。

may_come_up.what: Suggests Grab or Bolt for city rides
Airport transfer quotes a fixed price including tolls or not

sensitive_asked.what: Car rental asks driving licence and passport copy
